title: bay-diagnostic-recall · input · one question over the shop's own completed repair orders

query.description: the complaint, symptom or system in the technician's words

stop_words.description: shop jargon to ignore, from rubric.yaml retrieval.stop_words

standard.description: the name and version of the rubric.yaml this question is answered under; absent means the module refuses (Rung 0)

rows.description: completed repair orders for the period to search; they travel with the question and are never stored

vehicle_id.description: used to count return visits; never echoed raw

completed_date.description: date or date-time the repair order closed

note.description: technician free text; redacted of VIN, phone, email before it is echoed
